correctness.rationale: Exact killed-chain Green/cofactor formula and independent renewal-cycle reduction prove Q(s)=(231R(s^2))/(231R(s^2)+2sL(s^2)); L,R strictly positive on [0,1]. Differentiation gives quartic H. Rational signs H(4/5)<0<H(9/10) and H(99/100)>0>H(999/1000) force two distinct roots. The transformed quartic has exactly two Descartes sign changes, proving at most two roots globally. Both roots are simple and represent a strict minimum followed by a strict maximum. The standalone exact-rational checker passed 32 assertions, including six full 10-state resolvent comparisons. s=0 excluded.

value.rationale: Answers the qualitative existence aspect of a stated open resetting problem using a single ordinary geometric reset location and fully absorbing finite nearest-neighbor dynamics. The exact rational Descartes certificate reveals a new nonmonotonicity phenomenon (two strict stationary points), rather than an arbitrary benchmark or minor numerical improvement. It does not assert minimal size, broad classification, or application-sized probability gain.
